title: Moment transfer and spectral bounds for Boolean Doob kernels
abstract: We study positive potentials for Boolean noise and the associated reversible Doob kernels. Under a stationary floor, a critical moment cap and exact low-degree marginal matching, we construct potentials that grow exponentially at a vertex where their noise average decays exponentially. Despite an unbounded pointwise ratio, the entire spectrum of this family converges exponentially to that of Boolean noise. A quantitative inverse estimate for symmetric stationary scaling permits exact correction of the low Walsh coefficients. We also establish weak relaxation estimates, full-chain bounds under a positive normalized potential minimum, and separate potential smoothing from stationary-density smoothing. The unrestricted stationary spectral-gap problem remains open.
